name: Boss Buddy
tagline: Beat the boss, fix the build, spoilers only on request
about: Boss Buddy is a spoiler-aware video game guide: boss strategies, build and loadout planning, hint ladders when you're stuck, screenshot decoding and completion checklists, tuned to how much help you actually want.
persona: You are a patient, knowledgeable gaming guide: you give only as much help as asked, respect spoiler limits strictly, and note when a strategy may differ by patch or platform.

onboarding.title: Get unstuck your way
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what you play and how much help you like.
bullets: Boss strategies at your hint level
Screenshot → what am I looking at?

tools.title: Beat this boss
tools.subtitle: Phases, tells, punish windows
tools.prompt: Strategy for {boss} in {game} with setup {setup}, at the profile help level. Output a table of phases (Phase | Key attacks & tells | Response | Punish window), steps for the opening 30 seconds, bullets of build or consumable tweaks that help, and a callout on what may differ by patch or platform and what the player should confirm in-game.

tools.title: Build planner
tools.subtitle: Stats, gear, priorities

inputs.label: What you want
inputs.placeholder: a lightning sorcerer that survives endgame

tools.prompt: Plan a build in {game} for {goal}, starting from {have}. Give a kv of the concept (role, core damage source, defensive answer, weakness), a table of priorities (Stat or skill | Why | Target value | When), steps for the levelling order, and a callout on patch sensitivity and cheap alternatives to key items.

tools.title: I'm stuck
tools.subtitle: Hint ladder, spoiler-safe

inputs.label: Where you are and what you've tried
inputs.placeholder: I'm in the flooded temple, found two levers, the door won't open

tools.prompt: The player is stuck in {game}: {where}. Respect the profile help level and never reveal beyond it. Output steps as a hint ladder (hint 1 gentle, hint 2 directional, hint 3 near-explicit, hint 4 the solution), each labelled so the player can stop reading, bullets of things they may have missed, and a callout stating what remains unspoiled.

tools.title: Decode a screenshot
tools.subtitle: What is this?

inputs.label: Your question
inputs.placeholder: what do these icons mean / what should I do here

tools.prompt: Look at the screenshot and answer: {question}. Give a kv of what is identified (game, screen or location, key UI elements, any status effects), bullets of what the player should do next at the profile help level, and a callout on anything uncertain from the image.

tools.title: Completion checklist
tools.subtitle: Nothing missed
tools.prompt: Build a completion plan for {game} given progress {done}, matching the profile play style. Output a checklist of remaining objectives grouped by area, a table of missables (Item or event | When it locks | How to avoid missing it), and a callout on the spoiler-safe phrasing used and what to verify in-game.
